papers.title: Digital journaling enables privacy-preserving behavioral phenotyping and real-time risk monitoring at scale
papers.translated_title: 数字日记使隐私保护的行为表型分析和大规模实时风险监测成为可能
papers.author: Milham, M.
papers.summary: Background: Digital journaling may serve both as a low-intensity mental health intervention and as a source of longitudinal behavioral data. Its clinical effects and its potential for privacy-preserving behavioral phenotyping and risk-signal characterization require separate evaluation. Objective: This study evaluated the clinical effects of guided and unguided digital journaling and explored whether longitudinal journaling data could characterize reproducible patterns in mood and classifier-derived distress and risk signals. Methods: Part I was an 8-week randomized controlled trial with a 1-month follow-up among 665 assigned young adults with mild-to-moderate symptoms of anxiety or depression recruited via Prolific Academic. Participants were randomized to guided journaling plus mood check, unguided journaling plus mood check, mood check only, or passive control. Available follow-up PROMIS outcomes from 423 participants contributed to the intention-to-treat models. Part II comprised exploratory, non-preregistered analyses of more than 12,000 self-initiated mood observations and classifier-derived distress and risk signals. Selected behavioral dynamics were examined in an independent general-population dataset of 16,630 users. Results: Of 665 assigned participants, 158 (23.8%) were not invited to follow-up because of incomplete onboarding/linkage or administrative issues; 84 (12.6%) were invited but provided no follow-up outcomes. Overall, 423 (63.6%) provided at least one follow-up outcome, with similar availability across conditions (61.5-65.1%). Primary contamination-corrected analyses excluded nine passive-control participants who used the study app and yielded small anxiety estimates favoring journaling, with the largest arm-level estimate observed for guided journaling at week 12 (Cohen d=0.25). Secondary pooled estimates were approximately d=0.16 at week 8 and d=0.19 at week 12. Neither the arm-level nor pooled comparisons survived correction for multiple comparisons. Complementary Bayesian estimates were directionally consistent with lower anxiety but indicated substantial uncertainty regarding effect magnitude. We found no evidence of benefit for depression or functional impairment. In Part II, classifier-derived high-risk signals were more common among younger users (odds ratio 0.81 per year of age; P=.013). Classifier-derived distress and self-reported energy varied by time of day, and mood and risk states exhibited short-term persistence and escalation patterns. Selected behavioral dynamics were reproduced in the independent general-population dataset, although absolute rates differed between samples. Conclusions: The randomized trial yielded small, uncertain anxiety estimates favoring journaling, but these did not establish clinical benefit as no comparison survived statistical correction for multiple comparisons. No benefit was demonstrated for depression or functional impairment. Separately, the exploratory behavioral analyses showed that privacy-preserving longitudinal journaling data could be used to characterize reproducible temporal patterns in mood and classifier-derived distress and risk signals. These findings support further evaluation of digital journaling as a behavioral measurement and risk-signal characterization platform and motivate future trials of more targeted guided-journaling approaches matched to specific symptoms or therapeutic mechanisms. The study also highlights opportunities and procedural challenges in online panel-based digital trials. Trial Registration: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07126275.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：数字日记既可作为低强度心理健康干预手段，也可作为纵向行为数据的来源。其临床效果及其在隐私保护条件下进行行为表型分析和风险信号特征描述的潜力需要分别评估。目的：本研究评估了引导式和非引导式数字日记的临床效果，并探讨纵向日记数据能否刻画情绪以及分类器衍生的困扰和风险信号中的可重复模式。方法：第一部分是一项为期8周的随机对照试验，随访1个月，纳入665名通过Prolific Academic招募的、伴有轻至中度焦虑或抑郁症状的指定年轻成人。参与者被随机分配至引导式日记加情绪检查、非引导式日记加情绪检查、仅情绪检查或被动对照组。来自423名参与者的可用随访PROMIS结局纳入了意向性治疗模型。第二部分包括对超过12,000条自我发起的情绪观察以及分类器衍生的困扰和风险信号进行的探索性、非预注册分析。所选行为动力学在一个由16,630名用户组成的独立一般人群数据集中进行了检验。结果：在665名指定参与者中，158名（23.8%）因入组/链接不完整或行政问题未被邀请参加随访；84名（12.6%）被邀请但未提供随访结局。总体而言，423名（63.6%）提供了至少一项随访结局，各条件下的可用性相似（61.5-65.1%）。主要污染校正分析排除了9名使用了研究应用的被动对照参与者，产生了有利于日记的小幅焦虑估计值，其中引导式日记在第12周观察到最大的组别水平估计值（Cohen d=0.25）。次要合并估计在第8周约为d=0.16，在第12周约为d=0.19。组别水平和合并比较均未通过多重比较校正。补充的贝叶斯估计在方向上与较低的焦虑一致，但表明效应量的不确定性较大。我们未发现对抑郁或功能损害有益的 evidence。在第二部分中，分类器衍生的高风险信号在较年轻用户中更为常见（每增加一岁比值比为0.81；P=.013）。分类器衍生的困扰和自我报告的能量随时间变化，情绪和风险状态表现出短期持续性和升级模式。所选行为动力学在独立一般人群数据集中得到重现，尽管样本间的绝对率不同。结论：该随机试验产生了有利于日记的小幅、不确定的焦虑估计值，但这些结果并未确立临床获益，因为没有任何比较通过多重比较的统计校正。未证明对抑郁或功能损害有益。另外，探索性行为分析显示，隐私保护条件下的纵向日记数据可用于刻画情绪以及分类器衍生的困扰和风险信号中的可重复时间模式。这些发现支持进一步评估数字日记作为行为测量和风险信号特征描述平台，并推动未来开展针对特定症状或治疗机制的更有针对性引导式日记方法的试验。该研究还强调了在线面板数字试验中的机遇和程序性挑战。试验注册：ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07126275。

papers.title: Quantifying Academic Risk Factors for Student Depression Using WHO Frameworks: Odds Ratios, SHAP Explainability, and Tipping Point Analysis
papers.translated_title: 量化学生抑郁的学术风险因素：基于WHO框架的优势比、SHAP可解释性与临界点分析
papers.author: Ahmed, T.
papers.summary: Depression has become a serious concern for students worldwide. Aligned with the WHO Helping Adolescents Thrive (HAT) Guidelines and the Social Determinants of Health (SDoH) model, this study isolates five academically relevant factors- academic pressure, work/study hours, study satisfaction, sleep duration, and financial stress- from a dataset of 27,880 university students in India and quantifies their associations with depression. Unlike prior work that maximises classification accuracy, this study prioritises interpretability: logistic regression provides odds ratios (OR) with 95% confidence intervals, Random Forest (RF) and XGBoost rank predictors by feature importance, and SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) values extend the analysis to individual-level risk explanation. Sleep Duration is encoded as an ordinal integer (0-3) preserving its natural order, and Spearman correlations are computed on the original 27,880-row dataset prior to any resampling. SMOTE oversampling was applied exclusively to the training set, and performance was evaluated on the original imbalanced test set (n = 5,576). Both ensemble models achieve approximately 77-78% accuracy and an AUC of 0.845, confirmed by 5-fold pipeline cross-validation (CV AUC [~] 0.843). Academic pressure is the dominant risk factor (OR = 2.271; RF importance = 0.481; mean |SHAP| = 0.174), while study satisfaction (OR = 0.796) and sleep duration (OR = 0.835) are protective. Interaction analysis reveals how depression risk is amplified by low sleep, high financial stress, and extended study hours: under average conditions, the 50% risk threshold is crossed at Academic Pressure {approx} 3.04, and under compounded adverse conditions, this tipping point shifts to even lower pressure values. These findings provide data-driven thresholds aligned with WHO-endorsed modifiable determinants to support early detection and institutional counselling.
papers.translated_summary: 抑郁已成为全球学生面临的严重问题。本研究依据世界卫生组织《帮助青少年茁壮成长（HAT）指南》与健康社会决定因素（SDoH）模型，从印度27,880名大学生数据集中分离出五个与学业相关的因素——学业压力、工作/学习时长、学习满意度、睡眠时长和经济压力——并量化其与抑郁的关联。与以往追求分类准确率最大化的研究不同，本研究优先考虑可解释性：逻辑回归提供比值比（OR）及95%置信区间，随机森林（RF）和XGBoost按特征重要性对预测变量排序，SHAP（SHapley Additive exPlanations）值将分析扩展至个体层面的风险解释。睡眠时长被编码为有序整数（0-3）以保留其自然顺序，Spearman相关在任何重采样之前基于原始27,880行数据集计算。SMOTE过采样仅应用于训练集，性能在原始不平衡测试集（n = 5,576）上评估。两个集成模型均达到约77-78%的准确率和0.845的AUC，并经5折流水线交叉验证确认（CV AUC [~] 0.843）。学业压力是主要风险因素（OR = 2.271；RF重要性 = 0.481；平均|SHAP| = 0.174），而学习满意度（OR = 0.796）和睡眠时长（OR = 0.835）具有保护作用。交互分析揭示了低睡眠、高经济压力和延长学习时间如何放大抑郁风险：在平均条件下，50%风险阈值在学业压力约为3.04时被跨越，而在复合不利条件下，该临界点偏移至更低的压力值。这些发现提供了与WHO认可的可改变决定因素相一致的数据驱动阈值，可支持早期识别和机构心理咨询。

papers.title: The development and psychometric evaluation of the Post Activity Symptom Scale (PASS) for Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/ Chronic Fatigue Syndrome.
papers.translated_title: 肌痛性脑脊髓炎/慢性疲劳综合征活动后症状量表（PASS）的编制与心理测量学评价
papers.author: Horton, M.
papers.summary: Purpose: To develop and psychometrically evaluate a new scale measuring post-exertional malaise in people with myalgic encephalomyelitis (ME)/ chronic fatigue syndrome (CFS). Methods: A draft scale was co-produced with patient and clinician advisory groups. After extensive pilot testing, adults with ME/CFS completed the Post Activity Symptom Scale online and repeated it two weeks later to assess test-retest reliability and sensitivity to change. Rasch analysis assessed each domain for unidimensionality, targeting, internal reliability, item fit and local dependency. Then Rasch-transformed interval data and parametric statistics were used to assess criterion-related and discriminant validity (by comparison with measures of physical health and ME/CFS severity), test-retest reliability and minimal detectable difference. Results: The item regarding delay in PEM onset was an under-discriminating misfit anomaly which was inconsistent with the remaining PASS items. When this was removed, the PASS was a unidimensional, psychometrically robust scale. Criterion-related validity (r=0.58, p<0.001) was moderate and highly significant, discriminant validity (p<0.001) and test-retest reliability (ICC = 0.81) were excellent. The minimal detectable difference was 1.93/100. Participants found the PASS easy to complete, comprehensive and relevant. Conclusion: The Post Activity Symptom Scale is a valid, reliable, sensitive measure of people of PEM in ME/CFS
papers.translated_summary: 目的：开发并心理测量学评估一个测量肌痛性脑脊髓炎（ME）/慢性疲劳综合征（CFS）患者活动后不适的新量表。方法：与患者和临床医生顾问组共同制作量表草案。经过广泛试点测试后，ME/CFS成人患者在线完成活动后症状量表，并在两周后重测，以评估重测信度和变化敏感性。Rasch分析评估每个领域的单维性、目标性、内部信度、条目拟合和局部依赖性。然后使用Rasch转换的区间数据和参数统计评估效标关联效度和区分效度（通过与身体健康和ME/CFS严重程度测量比较）、重测信度和最小可检测差异。结果：关于PEM发作延迟的条目是一个区分度不足的失拟异常项，与其余PASS条目不一致。移除该条目后，PASS成为一个单维、心理测量学稳健的量表。效标关联效度（r=0.58，p<0.001）为中等且高度显著，区分效度（p<0.001）和重测信度（ICC = 0.81）极佳。最小可检测差异为1.93/100。参与者认为PASS易于完成、全面且相关。结论：活动后症状量表是测量ME/CFS患者PEM的有效、可靠、敏感的工具。

papers.title: Success Among Ethnic Minorities and International Medical Graduates in UK Medical Speciality Recruitment: A Longitudinal Analysis of NHS England Data (2021-2025)
papers.translated_title: 英国医学专科招聘中少数族裔与国际医学毕业生的成功情况：对英格兰国民医疗服务体系数据（2021-2025）的纵向分析
papers.author: Hum, R. M.
papers.summary: BackgroundWhile overall application volume by ethnic minority doctors into UK postgraduate medical training has expanded significantly, workforce diversity varies substantially across specialties. Previous reports have suggested that doctors from certain ethnic backgrounds and international medical graduates (IMGs) experience lower likelihoods of securing training posts, but granular longitudinal evaluations across all specialty training levels and recruitment stages remained limited. Therefore, this study evaluates longitudinal trends in self-reported ethnicity and country of qualification across postgraduate medical training in England between 2021 and 2025, maps specialty representation, and tests the hypothesis that recruitment success rates differ significantly between ethnic minority and White baseline applicants. MethodsWe conducted a retrospective national longitudinal analysis of mandatory NHS specialty recruitment data across England from 2021 to 2025, encompassing over 300,000 applications across ST1/CT1 (entry-level) and ST3+ (higher specialty) pathways. Applicants were categorised into census-aligned broad and granular ethnic groups, alongside IMG classifications. Unadjusted odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals were calculated using White graduates and internal sub-ethnic baselines as comparators. Specialty-level ecological correlations (Spearmans rho) were performed to evaluate whether international workforce reliance moderated ethnic recruitment disparities. ResultsBetween 2021 and 2025, applicant volume expanded rapidly, with ethnic minority applicants and IMGs comprising numerical majorities. However, Asian and Black applicants experienced substantially lower odds of receiving training offers compared to White baseline applicants across multiple high-volume specialties (e.g., emergency medicine and anaesthetics at ST1, where Black applicants faced multi-fold reductions in success odds: OR 0.03 to 0.05, p<0.001). Granular analyses revealed notable intra-ethnic heterogeneity, including lower success among Pakistani and Bangladeshi applicants compared to Indian applicants. Furthermore, UK graduates maintained higher offer success than IMGs across most specialties. Ecological correlations demonstrated that higher international applicant reliance was moderately and significantly associated with wider recruitment disparities at higher training levels for Black applicants {rho}=-0.43, p=0.019). ConclusionsCentralised medical recruitment in England exhibits some persistent ethnic and international qualification disparities despite rising application diversity. The findings highlight the necessity of disaggregating ethnic groups and addressing subjective evaluation vulnerabilities within multi-stage recruitment processes to foster equity. Trial registrationNot applicable
papers.translated_summary: 背景尽管少数族裔医生申请英国毕业后医学培训的总体数量已显著扩大，但不同专科之间的劳动力多样性差异很大。既往报告提示，某些族裔背景的医生和国际医学毕业生（IMGs）获得培训岗位的可能性较低，但针对所有专科培训层级和招聘阶段的细致纵向评估仍然有限。因此，本研究评估2021年至2025年间英格兰毕业后医学培训中自我报告的族裔和资格获取国的纵向趋势，绘制专科代表性图谱，并检验少数族裔与白人基线申请者之间招聘成功率存在显著差异的假设。方法我们对2021年至2025年英格兰范围内强制性NHS专科招聘数据进行了回顾性全国纵向分析，涵盖ST1/CT1（入门级）和ST3+（高级专科）路径的超过300,000份申请。申请者被划分为与人口普查一致的宽泛和细粒度族裔群体，以及IMG分类。使用白人毕业生和内部亚族裔基线作为对照，计算未调整比值比（ORs）及95%置信区间。进行专科层面的生态相关性分析（Spearman rho），以评估国际劳动力依赖是否调节族裔招聘差异。结果2021年至2025年间，申请者数量迅速扩大，少数族裔申请者和IMGs构成数量上的多数。然而，与白人基线申请者相比，亚裔和黑人申请者在多个高申请量专科中获得培训录用通知的比值显著较低（例如，ST1的急诊医学和麻醉学，黑人申请者的成功比值面临数倍下降：OR 0.03至0.05，p<0.001）。细粒度分析揭示了显著的族裔内部异质性，包括巴基斯坦和孟加拉国申请者的成功率低于印度申请者。此外，英国毕业生在大多数专科中的录用成功率高于IMGs。生态相关性表明，较高的国际申请者依赖度与黑人申请者在更高培训层级中更大的招聘差异呈中度且显著相关（rho=-0.43，p=0.019）。结论英格兰的集中化医学招聘尽管申请多样性上升，但仍表现出一些持续的族裔和国际资格差异。研究结果凸显了拆分族裔群体并解决多阶段招聘过程中主观评估脆弱性的必要性，以促进公平。试验注册不适用

papers.title: Development of a deep learning model for glomerulus detection and segmentation in kidney histopathology images
papers.translated_title: 开发用于肾脏组织病理学图像中肾小球检测和分割的深度学习模型
papers.author: Tosaki, T.
papers.summary: BackgroundEstimation of nephron number, an indicator of renal reserve, requires quantitative assessment of glomerular number and size in kidney biopsy specimens. We aimed to develop an automated system for quantitative measurement of glomerular areas from clinical kidney biopsy images, across diverse kidney diseases. MethodsWe developed a two-stage deep learning system combining Faster R-CNN for glomerular detection in whole-slide images (WSIs) and DeepLabV3+ for segmentation. Of 114 kidney biopsies (228 WSIs), 104 were used for model development and 10 for independent final evaluation. Agreement was assessed using the F1-score for detection, the Dice coefficient for segmentation, and the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC) for glomerular area measurement. Analysis was performed at 40x total magnification (2.331 m/pixel) and validated against 400x images. ResultsIn the independent evaluation set, the artificial intelligence (AI) model achieved a mean F1-score of 0.851 for detection, compared with 0.888 among experts. For segmentation, the Dice coefficient was 0.959 {+/-} 0.011 and the per-pair ICC (2,1) for area measurement was 0.989 {+/-} 0.009; both were comparable to inter-expert agreement. Bland-Altman analysis showed a mean bias of -344 m{superscript 2} (95% limits of agreement, -1904 to 1216 m{superscript 2}) between 40x and 400x measurements. ConclusionThe two-stage model achieved glomerular segmentation and area measurement comparable to expert agreement in independent clinical data, with detection performance approaching inter-expert agreement, and provided reliable measurements at low magnification. This automated approach may facilitate large-scale quantitative kidney pathology and nephron number estimation from clinical kidney biopsies.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：肾单位数量的估计是肾脏储备的指标，需要对肾活检标本中肾小球的数量和大小进行定量评估。我们旨在开发一个自动化系统，从临床肾脏活检图像中定量测量肾小球面积，涵盖多种肾脏疾病。方法：我们开发了一个两阶段深度学习系统，结合Faster R-CNN用于全切片图像（WSIs）中的肾小球检测，以及DeepLabV3+用于分割。在114例肾脏活检（228张WSIs）中，104例用于模型开发，10例用于独立最终评估。一致性评估采用检测的F1分数、分割的Dice系数以及肾小球面积测量的组内相关系数（ICC）。分析在40倍总放大倍数（2.331 m/像素）下进行，并针对400倍图像进行验证。结果：在独立评估集中，人工智能（AI）模型的检测平均F1分数为0.851，而专家为0.888。分割方面，Dice系数为0.959 {+/-} 0.011，面积测量的每对ICC（2,1）为0.989 {+/-} 0.009；两者均与专家间一致性相当。Bland-Altman分析显示，40倍与400倍测量之间的平均偏差为-344 m{superscript 2}（95%一致性界限，-1904至1216 m{superscript 2}）。结论：该两阶段模型在独立临床数据中实现了与专家一致性相当的肾小球分割和面积测量，检测性能接近专家间一致性，并在低放大倍数下提供了可靠的测量。这种自动化方法可能有助于从临床肾脏活检中进行大规模定量肾脏病理学和肾单位数量估计。

papers.title: The effect of carotid atherosclerosis and revascularization on cognition and dementia: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.translated_title: 颈动脉粥样硬化与血运重建对认知和痴呆的影响：系统综述与荟萃分析
papers.author: Box, C. V. J.
papers.summary: Background: Carotid artery atherosclerosis may accelerate cognitive decline and increase dementia risk, but evidence is fragmented and inconsistent, and benefit of revascularization on cognitive outcomes uncertain. Methods: We systematically searched Medline, Embase, Web of Science, the Cochrane Central Register, and Google Scholar for articles published until 11 November 2024, reporting change in cognition or dementia incidence in relation to carotid artery intima-media thickness, plaque, stenosis, and revascularization procedures. We excluded studies that investigated people with dementia, lacked a reference group, or had post-intervention follow-up <30 days. We additionally included new data from the Rotterdam Study, and results from the recent CREST-2 trial. Two independent reviewers extracted study data. Random-effects meta-analyses were performed if data allowed. Risk of bias was assessed using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale, Cochrane Risk of Bias, and ROBINS-I. Results: Of 5592 records identified, 97 studies were eligible, including 43 observational studies (N=100,326) and 54 intervention studies (N=15788, 6 randomized controlled trials). In observational studies, mostly among stroke-free individuals, intima-media thickness was associated with higher dementia risk (hazard ratio per 1-SD increase: 1.07, 95%CI 1.01-1.13; I2=24.8%; 5 studies), as was presence of 50-100% asymptomatic steno-occlusive disease (hazard ratio: 1.48, 95%CI 1.06 -2.07; I2=0.0%, 3 studies). Cognitive outcomes were too heterogeneous for meta-analysis, but 11/20 observational studies reported a significant association between carotid atherosclerosis and global cognition. In non-randomized intervention studies, carotid revascularization improved global cognition (standardized mean difference: 0.73, 95%CI 0.37 -1.09; I2=89.8%), but all studies were at high risk of bias, and heterogeneity was only partially explained by intervention type and study characteristics in meta-regression. Suggested benefit of stenting on cognition among Chinese patients (Standardized effect: 0.86 [0.57-1.16], 197 patients; and 1.09 [0.64-1.53], 90 patients, 2 trials) was not observed in the larger CREST-2 trial (Standardized effect: 0.03 [-0.09 to 0.15] and 0.02 [-0.09 to 0.14]), nor in post-hoc analyses of cognition in the ACAS trial and long-term dementia risk in ACST-1 (HR: 0.98 [0.75-1.28]). Conclusions: Carotid atherosclerosis is associated with increased risk of dementia. Current evidence does not support carotid revascularization for prevention of cognitive decline or dementia.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：颈动脉粥样硬化可能加速认知功能下降并增加痴呆风险，但证据零散且不一致，血运重建对认知结局的获益尚不确定。方法：我们系统检索了Medline、Embase、Web of Science、Cochrane Central Register和Google Scholar，检索截至2024年11月11日发表的文章，报告与颈动脉内中膜厚度、斑块、狭窄及血运重建手术相关的认知变化或痴呆发病率。我们排除了研究痴呆患者、缺乏参照组或干预后随访<30天的研究。我们额外纳入了鹿特丹研究的新数据以及近期CREST-2试验的结果。两名独立评审员提取研究数据。在数据允许的情况下进行随机效应荟萃分析。使用纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表、Cochrane偏倚风险工具和ROBINS-I评估偏倚风险。结果：在识别的5592条记录中，97项研究符合条件，包括43项观察性研究（N=100,326）和54项干预性研究（N=15788，6项随机对照试验）。在观察性研究中，大多为无卒中个体，内中膜厚度与较高的痴呆风险相关（每增加1个标准差的风险比：1.07，95%CI 1.01-1.13；I2=24.8%；5项研究），存在50-100%无症状狭窄-闭塞性疾病亦如此（风险比：1.48，95%CI 1.06-2.07；I2=0.0%，3项研究）。认知结局异质性过大，无法进行荟萃分析，但20项观察性研究中有11项报告颈动脉粥样硬化与整体认知之间存在显著关联。在非随机干预研究中，颈动脉血运重建改善了整体认知（标准化均数差：0.73，95%CI 0.37-1.09；I2=89.8%），但所有研究均存在高偏倚风险，且荟萃回归仅部分解释了干预类型和研究特征的异质性。中国患者中支架置入对认知的提示性获益（标准化效应：0.86 [0.57-1.16]，197例患者；以及1.09 [0.64-1.53]，90例患者，2项试验）在较大规模的CREST-2试验中未观察到（标准化效应：0.03 [-0.09至0.15]和0.02 [-0.09至0.14]），在ACAS试验的认知事后分析及ACST-1的长期痴呆风险中亦未观察到（HR：0.98 [0.75-1.28]）。结论：颈动脉粥样硬化与痴呆风险增加相关。当前证据不支持通过颈动脉血运重建来预防认知功能下降或痴呆。

papers.title: Genetic effects on serum and urine metabolites across ancestries and their links to disease
papers.translated_title: 遗传对跨祖先血清和尿液代谢物的影响及其与疾病的关联
papers.author: Steinbrenner, I.
papers.summary: Genome-wide association studies of the metabolome have predominantly examined European-ancestry populations using a single biofluid, constraining both the discovery of metabolite quantitative trait loci (mQTLs) and the resolution of causal variant finemapping. Here, we report a multi-ancestry genome-wide association study of 1,955 serum and urine metabolites in 4,431 European American and African American participants from the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities study. We identify 969 mQTLs for 553 metabolites, 30% unreported in studies of matched biofluid and ancestry, and replicate 91-99% of testable mQTLs in two independent cohorts. In the African American sample with balanced sample sizes, 36% of metabolites with mQTLs are serum-specific, 39% urine-specific, and 25% shared, demonstrating complementary genetic architecture. Only 23 of 632 candidate ancestry-specific mQTLs show heterogeneous effects beyond variant availability and power, yet allele frequency differences expose functional variants such as an SLC28A1 splice variant, virtually absent in Europeans, that increases urine uridine excretion, implicating impaired CNT1-mediated renal nucleoside reabsorption. Multi-ancestry finemapping improves credible set resolution, and colocalization with the Million Veteran Program phenome links the catalog to cardiometabolic, kidney and liver traits consistent with prioritized gene function. Integrating biofluids and ancestries enhances genetic discovery and mechanistic characterization of the human metabolome.
papers.translated_summary: 代谢组的全基因组关联研究主要使用单一生物体液在欧洲血统人群中进行，这限制了对代谢物数量性状位点（mQTLs）的发现以及因果变异精细定位的分辨率。在此，我们报告了一项多血统全基因组关联研究，基于动脉粥样硬化风险社区研究中4，431名欧洲裔美国人和非裔美国人参与者的1，955种血清和尿液代谢物。我们鉴定了553种代谢物的969个mQTLs，其中30%在匹配生物体液和血统的研究中未见报道，并在两个独立队列中重复验证了91-99%可测试的mQTLs。在样本量均衡的非裔美国人样本中，具有mQTLs的代谢物中36%为血清特异性，39%为尿液特异性，25%为共享，展示了互补的遗传架构。632个候选血统特异性mQTLs中仅23个显示出超越变异可用性和统计效力的异质性效应，然而等位基因频率差异揭示了功能性变异，如一个在欧洲人中几乎不存在的SLC28A1剪接变异，该变异增加尿苷排泄，暗示CNT1介导的肾脏核苷重吸收受损。多血统精细定位提高了可信集分辨率，与百万退伍军人计划表型的共定位将该目录与心脏代谢、肾脏和肝脏性状相关联，与优先基因功能一致。整合生物体液和血统增强了人类代谢组的遗传发现和机制表征。

papers.title: Room-Aware Transformer for Activities of Daily Living Recognition in Adults with Mild Neurocognitive Disorder Using Ambient Sensors: Development and Evaluation Study
papers.translated_title: 面向轻度神经认知障碍成人日常生活活动识别的房间感知Transformer基于环境传感器的研究：开发与评估
papers.author: Abdalnabi, N.
papers.summary: ABSTRACT Background: Unobtrusive recognition of activities of daily living (ADLs) from ambient sensors may support longitudinal assessment of everyday functioning in adults with mild neurocognitive disorder (mild NCD). However, real-world activity recognition is complicated by heterogeneous home layouts, sensor configurations, routines, and class distributions. Objective: This study evaluated whether a room-aware Transformer that preserves location-specific sensor structure improves participant-level ADL recognition relative to a global Transformer and a stacked unidirectional long short-term memory (LSTM) network. Methods: Following pilot feasibility testing with two adult volunteers, we analyzed five homes of adults with mild NCD, comprising 92,765 minute-level observations across 67 annotated home-days. Motion, temperature, illuminance, humidity, and door-contact data were aligned to participant activity logs. The original labels were harmonized into eight categories. Models were developed separately for each home using 10-, 30-, and 60-minute windows. Complete calendar days were assigned to mutually exclusive training, validation, and chronological test sets, and no sequence crossed a day or partition boundary. The same partitions and evaluation procedures were used for all three architectures. Performance was assessed on held-out test days using accuracy, per-class F1 score, and micro- and macro-averaged one-versus-rest area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). Results: The room-aware Transformer achieved the highest or tied accuracy in 9 of 15 home-window comparisons. Its accuracy ranged from 0.27 to 0.57, micro-AUC from 0.57 to 0.82, and macro-AUC from 0.54 to 0.78. Across the 15 settings, mean accuracy was similar for the room-aware and global Transformers and higher than for the LSTM. Mean micro-AUC and macro-AUC were marginally higher for the global Transformer than for the room-aware Transformer. The room-aware model showed its clearest gains in selected contexts, including Homes C and E at 10 minutes and Home A at 60 minutes, but no architecture or temporal window was uniformly optimal. Sleep/Rest was the most consistently recognized activity, whereas low-support activities frequently had low F1 scores despite moderate or high AUC values. Conclusions: Room-specific feature processing provided context-dependent gains in participant-level ADL classification, particularly for accuracy in several home-window settings. The marked variation across homes, activities, and temporal windows supports personalized model development, class-sensitive evaluation, and validation in larger and more diverse residential samples before clinical use. Keywords: activities of daily living; mild neurocognitive disorder; ambient sensors; deep learning; artificial intelligence
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 背景：基于环境传感器对日常生活活动（ADLs）进行非侵入式识别，可能有助于对轻度神经认知障碍（轻度NCD）成人日常功能的纵向评估。然而，现实世界中的活动识别因家庭布局、传感器配置、作息规律和类别分布的异质性而变得复杂。目的：本研究评估了一种保留位置特异性传感器结构的房间感知Transformer，相较于全局Transformer和堆叠单向长短期记忆（LSTM）网络，是否能改善参与者水平的ADL识别。方法：在对两名成年志愿者进行试点可行性测试后，我们分析了五个轻度NCD成人的家庭，涵盖67个标注家庭日中的92，765条分钟级观测数据。运动、温度、照度、湿度和门接触数据与参与者活动日志对齐。原始标签被统一为八个类别。模型针对每个家庭分别开发，使用10、30和60分钟窗口。完整日历日被分配到互斥的训练集、验证集和时间顺序测试集，且任何序列均不跨越日或分区边界。三种架构使用相同的分区和评估程序。在留出测试日上使用准确率、每类F1分数以及微观和宏观平均的一对其余受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）评估性能。结果：房间感知Transformer在15项家庭-窗口比较中的9项达到最高或并列最高准确率。其准确率范围为0.27至0.57，微观AUC为0.57至0.82，宏观AUC为0.54至0.78。在15种设置中，房间感知和全局Transformer的平均准确率相似，且高于LSTM。全局Transformer的平均微观AUC和宏观AUC略高于房间感知Transformer。房间感知模型在特定情境中显示出最明显的增益，包括10分钟窗口的Home C和Home E以及60分钟窗口的Home A，但没有一种架构或时间窗口始终最优。睡眠/休息是最 consistently 被识别的活动，而低支持活动尽管AUC值中等或较高，F1分数却常常较低。结论：房间特异性特征处理在参与者水平ADL分类中提供了情境依赖的增益，特别是在若干家庭-窗口设置中的准确率方面。家庭、活动和时间窗口之间的显著差异支持个性化模型开发、类别敏感评估以及在临床使用前在更大、更多样化的住宅样本中进行验证。关键词：日常生活活动；轻度神经认知障碍；环境传感器；深度学习；人工智能

papers.title: Cardiovascular hospital demand projections for Suriname up to 2050 with implications for health system planning
papers.translated_title: 苏里南至2050年心血管医院需求预测及其对卫生系统规划的影响
papers.author: Dhanpat, R. A.
papers.summary: Abstract This study developed a data-driven decision-support framework to project annual hospital admissions and in-hospital mortality for ischemic heart disease (IHD) and cerebrovascular disease in Suriname from 2023 through 2050. Using retrospective discharge data from 2013-2022 across three major public hospitals--accounting for approximately 71.8% of national admissions--historical trends were analyzed using log-linear regression across six age groups. Population projections relied on the UN World Population Prospects 2024 Revision. Future admissions and deaths were modelled across five policy pathways: status quo, current HEARTS, strengthened HEARTS, full HEARTS targets, and full HEARTS combined with improved hospital survival, with uncertainty assessed via 10,000 Monte Carlo simulations. Results showed that admission rates increased for most age groups between 2013 and 2022. Under the status quo pathway, combined cardiovascular admissions are projected to reach 15,592 in 2030, 30,772 in 2040, and 62,643 in 2050. Compared to the status quo in 2050, projected admissions would drop to 58,073 under current HEARTS, 41,690 under strengthened HEARTS, and 27,469 under full HEARTS--representing median reductions of 6.0%, 33.5%, and 56.1%, respectively. Additionally, projected 2050 deaths would decrease from 2,644 under the status quo to 1,155 under full HEARTS, and further to 924 with improved hospital survival. Cardiovascular hospital demand could rise substantially if historical trends continue, impacting health-system capacity. While not causal estimates or precise forecasts, these modelled pathways illustrate how routine health data can create a transparent framework to guide cardiovascular prevention, resource allocation, and health-system planning in Suriname.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 本研究开发了一个数据驱动的决策支持框架，用于预测2023年至2050年苏里南缺血性心脏病（IHD）和脑血管疾病的年度住院人数及院内死亡率。利用2013—2022年三家主要公立医院（约占全国住院量的71.8%）的回顾性出院数据，采用对数线性回归对六个年龄组的历史趋势进行分析。人口预测依据联合国《世界人口展望2024年修订版》。未来住院人数和死亡人数在五种政策路径下进行建模：维持现状、当前HEARTS、强化HEARTS、全面HEARTS目标，以及全面HEARTS结合改善院内生存率，并通过10,000次蒙特卡洛模拟评估不确定性。结果显示，2013年至2022年间大多数年龄组的住院率呈上升趋势。在维持现状路径下，预计合并心血管住院人数将在2030年达到15,592例，2040年达到30,772例，2050年达到62,643例。与2050年维持现状相比，当前HEARTS路径下预计住院人数将降至58,073例，强化HEARTS路径下降至41,690例，全面HEARTS路径下降至27,469例——中位降幅分别为6.0%、33.5%和56.1%。此外，2050年预计死亡人数将从维持现状路径下的2,644例降至全面HEARTS路径下的1,155例，若结合改善院内生存率则进一步降至924例。若历史趋势持续，心血管住院需求可能大幅上升，对卫生系统承载能力造成影响。尽管这些并非因果估计或精确预测，但所建模的政策路径展示了如何利用常规卫生数据构建透明框架，以指导苏里南的心血管预防、资源配置和卫生系统规划。

papers.title: Human-centered design can optimize operational details of an implementation strategy: Experiences from a peer-based hypertension medication delivery program in western Kenya
papers.translated_title: 以人为中心的设计可以优化实施策略的运营细节：来自肯尼亚西部一项基于同伴的高血压药物递送项目的经验
papers.author: Vedanthan, R.
papers.summary: Background: Human-centered design (HCD) is a co-creation approach that is increasingly being utilized by implementation science researchers to engage key stakeholders in developing contextually appropriate health interventions and implementation strategies. The exact role of HCD in implementation research, however, remains uncertain. We describe the process, outcome, and experiences of using HCD to develop the operational details of an implementation strategy based on a pre-existing scaffolding that consisted of combining community-based peer medication delivery with health information technology (HIT) to improve medication adherence among hypertension patients in rural western Kenya. Methods: A design team of 22 members was formed representing key stakeholders: hypertension patients, healthcare workers, pharmacists, peers, HIT personnel, policy/program leaders, and implementation researchers. We conducted six meetings utilizing established HCD principles and processes (inspiration, brainstorming, conceptualization, creation, iteration, and finalization), aimed at developing a final implementation strategy with full operational details. Quantitative assessment of acceptability and appropriateness was conducted among healthcare workers, patients, and peers, using the Acceptability of Intervention Measure and Intervention Appropriateness Measure. Results: The design team developed key operational details across five domains: peer recruitment, training and monitoring; HIT; medication delivery; medication payment; and stakeholder identification. Acceptability and appropriateness scores (maximum of 20) were favorable among all participants, but mean scores were notably higher among patients with hypertension (19.3, 19.2) and peers (19.2, 19.2) compared to healthcare workers (17.7, 17.3). Specific recommendations were made to improve the acceptability and appropriateness of the strategy. These findings were subsequently used to develop a final iteration of the implementation strategy. Conclusion: HCD was feasible and useful in optimizing the operational details of our implementation strategy, aligning it with the healthcare goals and needs of the community. It allowed end-users to co-create with researchers, ultimately yielding high pre-implementation acceptability and appropriateness, which we anticipate will ultimately enhance implementation success.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：以人为本的设计（HCD）是一种共同创造方法，越来越多地被实施科学研究者用于让关键利益相关者参与制定符合情境的卫生干预措施和实施策略。然而，HCD在实施研究中的确切作用仍不确定。我们描述了使用HCD在既有框架基础上制定实施策略操作细节的过程、结果和体验，该框架将社区同伴药物配送与卫生信息技术（HIT）相结合，以改善肯尼亚西部农村高血压患者的服药依从性。方法：成立了一个由22名成员组成的设计团队，代表关键利益相关者：高血压患者、卫生工作者、药剂师、同伴、HIT人员、政策/项目领导者和实施研究者。我们召开了六次会议，运用既定的HCD原则和流程（启发、头脑风暴、概念化、创造、迭代和最终确定），旨在制定具有完整操作细节的最终实施策略。使用干预措施可接受性量表和干预措施适当性量表，对卫生工作者、患者和同伴进行了可接受性和适当性的定量评估。结果：设计团队在五个领域制定了关键操作细节：同伴招募、培训和监测；HIT；药物配送；药物支付；以及利益相关者识别。所有参与者的可接受性和适当性得分（最高20分）均良好，但高血压患者（19.3，19.2）和同伴（19.2，19.2）的平均得分明显高于卫生工作者（17.7，17.3）。提出了改善该策略可接受性和适当性的具体建议。这些发现随后被用于制定实施策略的最终迭代版本。结论：HCD在优化我们实施策略的操作细节方面是可行且有用的，使其与社区的卫生目标和需求相一致。它使最终用户能够与研究者共同创造，最终产生了较高的实施前可接受性和适当性，我们预计这将最终提高实施成功率。
